name: @minih-plugin/minih.inbox-mail
description: Watch your mailboxes — a listed provider, a mail server you type in, or either one through an HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy — notify only what matters, and work through them in one Inbox panel: day-grouped list with previews, search and filters, delete and archive, write/reply/reply-all/forward with attachments sent by the host, and one attachment saved wherever you pick. No model calls.
